notifications.list.title: List notifications
notifications.list.description: Page through the caller's side's notifications: the keyword matches title and content; filter by type, priority, target and published state.
notifications.get.title: Get notification
notifications.get.description: Get a notification with its delivery targets.
notifications.create.title: Create notification
notifications.create.description: Create a notification draft, optionally publishing it at once: role, department and user targets need at least one ID, and departments exist only on the tenant side. Publishing at once also needs notification.notifications.publish.
notifications.update.title: Update notification
notifications.update.description: Replace a notification draft, including its targets; published notifications cannot be changed.
notifications.delete.title: Delete notifications
notifications.delete.description: Delete notifications in bulk; published ones also leave their recipients' inboxes.
notifications.publish.title: Publish notification
notifications.publish.description: Publish a draft: resolve the active recipients of the caller's side from its targets, write their inbox entries and push them in real time after commit; a notification is published only once.
notifications.remind.title: Remind recipients
notifications.remind.description: Remind: push a published notification again to recipients who have not read it, or not confirmed it when confirmation is required.
notifications.read_stats.title: Get read statistics
notifications.read_stats.description: Read statistics: recipients, read, unread and confirmed counts.
notifications.recipients.title: List recipients
notifications.recipients.description: Page through the recipients of a published notification with their read and confirmation state; optionally only unread or unconfirmed ones.
inbox.list.title: List inbox entries
inbox.list.description: Page through your own inbox on the current side (published and within their visibility window): the keyword matches title and content; filter by read state and type or show only pending items.
inbox.banners.title: Get banner notifications
inbox.banners.description: Your unread banner notifications, shown at the top of the page.
inbox.popups.title: Get popup notifications
inbox.popups.description: Your popup notifications not shown yet; each pops up once after sign-in.
inbox.mandatory.title: Get mandatory notifications
inbox.mandatory.description: Your unread mandatory notifications; pages are blocked until they are read.
inbox.mark_read.title: Mark as read
inbox.mark_read.description: Mark entries of your own inbox as read.
inbox.mark_all_read.title: Mark all as read
inbox.mark_all_read.description: Mark every visible unread entry of your inbox on the current side as read.
inbox.confirm.title: Confirm notification
inbox.confirm.description: Confirm a notification in your inbox that asks for confirmation; it is marked read too.
inbox.mark_popup_shown.title: Mark popup as shown
inbox.mark_popup_shown.description: Record that one of your popup notifications has been shown so it does not pop up again.
inbox.delete.title: Delete inbox entries
inbox.delete.description: Delete entries from your own inbox; the notifications themselves are unaffected.
message_templates.list.title: List message templates
message_templates.list.description: Page through the message templates of the caller's side and of the platform (read-only to tenants, who override them with the same code).
message_templates.get.title: Get message template
message_templates.get.description: Get one of the message templates.
message_templates.create.title: Create message template
message_templates.create.description: Create message templates on the caller's side; codes are unique per side.
message_templates.update.title: Update message template
message_templates.update.description: Edit message templates; the code does not change.
message_templates.delete.title: Delete message templates
email_configs.list.title: List email configurations
email_configs.list.description: Page through the email configurations of the caller's side.
email_configs.get.title: Get email configuration
email_configs.get.description: Get one of the email configurations.
email_configs.create.title: Create email configuration
email_configs.create.description: Create email configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side.
email_configs.update.title: Update email configuration
email_configs.update.description: Edit email configurations; the code does not change.
email_configs.set_default.title: Set default email configuration
email_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the email configurations the caller's side default used for sending.
email_configs.delete.title: Delete email configurations
sms_configs.list.title: List SMS configurations
sms_configs.list.description: Page through the SMS configurations of the caller's side.
sms_configs.get.title: Get SMS configuration
sms_configs.get.description: Get one of the SMS configurations.
sms_configs.create.title: Create SMS configuration
sms_configs.create.description: Create SMS configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side.
sms_configs.update.title: Update SMS configuration
sms_configs.update.description: Edit SMS configurations; the code does not change.
sms_configs.set_default.title: Set default SMS configuration
sms_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the SMS configurations the caller's side default used for sending.
sms_configs.delete.title: Delete SMS configurations
emails.list.title: List email send records
emails.list.description: Page through the email send records of the caller's side.
emails.get.title: Get email send record
emails.get.description: Get one of the email send records.
emails.resend.title: Resend emails
emails.resend.description: Resend email send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected.
emails.cancel.title: Cancel queued emails
emails.delete.title: Delete email send records
emails.delete.description: Delete email send records in bulk.
sms.list.title: List SMS send records
sms.list.description: Page through the SMS send records of the caller's side.
sms.get.title: Get SMS send record
sms.get.description: Get one of the SMS send records.
sms.resend.title: Resend SMS
sms.resend.description: Resend SMS send records: back to queued with the attempt count reset; queued and sending ones are rejected.
sms.cancel.title: Cancel queued SMS
sms.delete.title: Delete SMS send records
sms.delete.description: Delete SMS send records in bulk.
bot_configs.list.title: List bot configurations
bot_configs.list.description: Page through the bot configurations of the caller's side.
bot_configs.get.title: Get bot configuration
bot_configs.get.description: Get one of the bot configurations.
bot_configs.create.title: Create bot configuration
bot_configs.create.description: Create bot configurations on the caller's side; codes are unique per side.
bot_configs.update.title: Update bot configuration
bot_configs.update.description: Edit bot configurations; the code does not change.
bot_configs.set_default.title: Set default bot configuration
bot_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled entry of the bot configurations the caller's side default used for sending.
bot_configs.delete.title: Delete bot configurations
telegram_bots.list.title: List Telegram bots
telegram_bots.list.description: Page through the platform-hosted Telegram bots; tokens are never shown.
telegram_bots.get.title: Get Telegram bot
telegram_bots.create.title: Create Telegram bot
telegram_bots.create.description: Create a Telegram bot: names are unique and the token is stored encrypted; admins, the group allow-list and broadcast chats are comma-separated integer IDs, the command allow-list is comma-separated command names.
telegram_bots.update.title: Update Telegram bot
telegram_bots.update.description: Edit a Telegram bot; leaving the token empty keeps it.
telegram_bots.delete.title: Delete Telegram bots
